text: Program Description 1. Introduction to Chinese Language Program Editor Notes: The course is taught in Chinese and provides different levels of study. The program is divided into Elementary Level (A, B), Intermediate Level (C, D), and Advanced Level (E). In total, there are 18-week courses a term. Study Place: OUC Fushan Campus, No.23 Eastern HongKong Road. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: This program offers 8 main courses for international students. School Introduction Editor Notes: Ocean University of China is a comprehensive university under the direct jurisdiction of the State Ministry of Education. There are over 20,000 registered students at Ocean University of China , including 4,500 Master's and Doctoral students and over 500 international students. Among the 2,300 faculty members there are many nationally and internationally recognized experts and scholars, 8 academicians of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and 5 academicians of Chinese Academy of Engineering. Ocean University of China (hereinafter referred to as OUC) is located in Qingdao, a renowned summer resort and an attractive historic tourist city of scenic beauty and temperate climate. Learn More about Ocean University of China. 6. International Education Center Editor Notes: OUC is now offering a large range of programs to international students, including some tailor-made programs. Each year more than 1300 international students from over 50 countries pursue their Certificate/Diploma/Bachelor's degree/Master's degree/Ph.D in our university. Our programs, especially known for their high standards of teaching and considerate services have been attractive to students from all over the world. Various cooperation has been set up with world-famous universities from different countries, such as Germany, USA, U.K. Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia etc. 7.
